usedFor: Airbrush makes images from a prompt, and “Create Art” runs whenever another app hands it a request.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order Created” in Lemon Squeezy, then “Create Art” in Airbrush
bestTemplate.why: Each paid order can turn into a piece of art made by the action.

watchOut: Every event you connect runs “Create Art” once, so test with a single event before a busy trigger.
